changelog:
- Added optional contact channels (WECHAT, WEBSITE) for display as a watermark; can be toggled via SHOW_CONTACT_WATERMARK (default on).
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and references/proposal-structure.md for the new watermark feature.
- Modified assets/proposal-template.html and scripts/generate_proposal.py to support the contact watermark and related tokens.
- Removed obsolete file skill-card.md.
summary: Generates client-ready, single-page HTML proposals for freelancers, solo consultants, and small studios. This skill should be used when a user wants to create a polished sales proposal, quote, or pitch document to send to a client. Triggered by requests like 帮我写个接单提案, 给客户做个报价单, 生成服务方案书, or 做个能发给甲方的方
